items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that suits dry, sensitive-looking skin without stripping it.
A ceramide moisturizer to support the skin's barrier and help with the low moisture score.
A mineral SPF with iron oxides that protects easily flushed skin and softly evens the look of visible redness.

response.routine_note: I left out the 15% vitamin C serum and 10% glycolic toner because strong acids can sting and add to the look of redness on dry, sensitive skin, so start with this gentle cleanser, moisturizer and morning SPF. Since you say your face is always red, please have a dermatologist look at it before adding any actives.
